source.label: CPG FY2025 and 1H2026 PSE financial summary

normalization.formula: reported PHP book value per share

CPG.route_reason: Residential projects and leasing property require property-level RNAV/SOTP; P/B is a finite screen until the fair-value and common-claim bridge is reviewed.
CPG.intrinsic_blocker: Property-level fair values, realization taxes, project cash flows, preferred claims, and common shares are not reconciled.
CPG.source_warning: The financial summary reports book value, not an independently appraised property RNAV; preferred-share claims are not fully bridged.

CDC.route_reason: Post-merger CDC common equity and property interests require a reconciled SOTP/RNAV before a current per-share estimate.
